# held standpoint

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:heldStandpoint`](gmeow-heldStandpoint.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/heldStandpoint>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)

The standpoint claim that the deceiver actually holds to be true — the private belief or position that contrasts with the projected standpoint in a deception event. Non-functional: a complex deception may involve multiple held standpoints.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md)
